# Model check

A **track** is one sequential line of work; steps in the same track run one after another and never overlap, so anything that happens in parallel belongs in a separate track. A **step** has exactly one duration kind: `fixed` (a number of seconds), `variable` (a range with a default for planning), or `indefinite` (runs until the person stops it). A **startTrigger** anchors a step to the clock (`programStart`, `programStartOffset`) or to another step's end or start (`afterStep`, `afterStepWithBuffer`, `compound`) or to manual action (`manual`). **stepId**s must be unique across the entire program, not just within one track. Every `task` that a step claims must have a matching entry in `resourceConstraints` with a `maxConcurrent` value that enforces the resource limit (one oven, two burners, three lanes, one coach). Work that repeats n times (n trays, n samples, n lanes doing the same work) goes on a single step with `replicates: {count: n, mode: ...}`, never as n copies of the step; downstream steps chain with `instances: "each"` per repetition or `instances: "all"` to wait for all of them, and when a holding area (cooling rack, rotor, lane queue) only fits k items at once, set `maxInFlight: k` to hold the upstream work rather than strand the downstream.

For this swim practice:

| task | maxConcurrent | meaning |
|------|---------------|---------|
| lane | 3 | three lanes run in parallel |
| blocks | 1 | one set of starting blocks; sprint work serializes |
| coach | 1 | one coach on deck; briefing, observation, sprint timing are sequential or occur within the coach's presence |

```json
{
  "acknowledgement": "tracks are sequential lines of work; one duration kind per step; triggers link steps; every task needs a resourceConstraint; stepIds are global",
  "resourceConstraints": [
    { "task": "lane", "maxConcurrent": 3 },
    { "task": "blocks", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "coach", "maxConcurrent": 1 }
  ],
  "actors": 1
}
```
